about: Expected result-block values for the Elevane rehearsal ROM and the level 3 demo ROMs (elevane-l3-*.nds; an item with "demo" is graded from that demo's block, "demos" maps name to block id = FNV-1a 32 of the name), judged by tools/judge.py. Block layout: arm9/source/game/rehearsal.h. An item may depend on a flag bit ("requires"); when it is clear the item is n/a (DeSmuME returns 0 from the polygon RAM counters). "known" lists, per emulator version and renderer, the items (gating or informational) expected to fail there; judge.py --profile passes only when the failing set matches exactly. Pixel counts read every 8th line (24 of 192) because the read must end inside the VBlank; hole counts are the worst seen over all frames of a kind. A profile also lists the items that are n/a there ("na").

boot.frame: the block is published at about frame 2500 (melonDS); run at least 3500, the examples use 4000
boot.note: plays the first puzzle of every chapter (stack piles, layers, several parts) with a fixed script through the live play scene, then the two showcase presets, 120 calls each; no save chip, no NitroFS

sources.report:<ref>: a hardware report by a third party (e.g. report:melonDS#2618); gating
sources.hw:<model>: measured by us on real hardware; gating
sources.rom: decided by the ROM's own deterministic logic alone, independent of the emulator (puzzle solving, counts); gating
sources.unconfirmed: no hardware value yet, or a result that depends on how an emulator handles capture, bank mapping or DMA timing (not documented in GBATEK); informational only, never fails the run (a profile still compares it)

known_note: Measured 2026-11-12 with ./build.sh output (the rehearsal and all nine l3-* demos, fresh logs on every profile), not on hardware. Items listed under "ng" are expected to fail on that emulator version; judge.py --profile NAME exits 0 only when the GATING failing set equals the list (informational items that changed are reported, not compared). melonDS master 4ce2188 GL/Compute fail the two HBlank DMA hole items (melonDS#2618). When a newer emulator passes an item listed here, --profile reports NEWLY PASSING and exits 1: update the profile after checking.

screens.note: 1x screenshots of a renderer against the same emulator's software renderer (tools/compare.py --phase). Measured 2026-11-11: melonDS 1.1 GL/Compute differ by at most 305 (dual) and 1138 (showcase) pixels of 98304 (text edges and antialiasing); master 4ce2188 GL/Compute differ by 9000-17400 in the showcase (the #2618 defect). Frames are consecutive: two in the dual phase, four in the showcase (preset 1 alternates between two picture kinds).
